verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for accounting SaaS like Moneybird, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows an MCP server that lets external AI chats (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) connect to the API. That is an adjacent integration channel, not an assistant built into the product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
